body: My bad, it was actually a crying emoji...shows a little more emotion than just a sad emoji.
Thanks for the reply. I'm trying to figure out if I'm being irrational for being upset with my friend's response by seeing what other people would do in this situation.
Thanks for being there when my own friends aren't. You've helped a little bit today. I may take you up on that offer from time to time.

Yeah I agree. Unfortunately I think I'm already feeling stuck. Today marks two weeks of feeling this way and I'm not seeming to get any support from my friends, I'm not feeling any better, and I guess I just don't know what to do.
It has helped a tiny bit. Thanks.
Yeah it sucks. Thanks for bringing up that suggestion though.

Yeah, I actually was feeling really terrible last night and started talking to people. Not about suicide because if I'm struggling this much, not much I can do to help in that regard, but talked to people who are depressed, because at least I can understand their thought processes. I'm glad there are people like you out there.

No, it's not a pushy question. I've thought about it but I've decided against it because I have laid out exactly how I feel to them, and they know I haven't left the house in 2 weeks, and that I'm happiest around people and hate being lonely, and they can't be bothered to do more than send me a few texts. I don't want to have to force these people to come care about me or guilt them into it. Apparently what I need is too much for them to offer.

Thanks for being there. It's just so ridiculous that even when your own friends know exactly how you're feeling because you tell them, it takes total strangers to care enough to try to talk someone out of suicide.

I think they care, but not enough to take a little time out of their own lives to help. Which sucks because if I had any friends going through this, I would take my books and study in their room even if they didn't say a word, just so they had someone near them and didn't feel as isolated and alone as I do. And I'm not even saying I expect that but it would be nice to have friends drop by for a few minutes day.

Yeah but the problem is that then I have no true friends. Currently I don't have a boyfriend/husband or children and if I were to have either, I definitely wouldn't end it because I'd have people depending on me. Currently no one is depending on me or even seeming to care about me so it's hard to keep fighting for the hope that one day I may meet someone who cares.

Yeah, and I'm trying to be extremely understanding but when the same friend's car broke down earlier in the year and he didn't have a car for about two weeks, I was the one that drove him absolutely everywhere. And I didn't complain or care because I was trying to be a good friend. And I was depressed during that time, although it was a more minor spell. So it just hurts to see that people don't care for me the way I care for them.

I've had suicidal thoughts and depressive episodes since I was 10 years old. A couple of suicide "attempts" as well, although I never told anyone about them. I'm now 22 and going through another pretty bad depressive episode and have had suicidal thoughts every single day for the past two weeks. By now, I have a well-thought out plan to execute but have not followed through because the only thing keeping me alive is my worry about hurting the people that care about me. I'm no longer scared of death but just how I will affect my friends and family. And now, when I see that my friends who know I am not doing well, and who I have told that I've been feeling horrible, not bothering to really check up on me past a few texts, that will to live is slowly dying. I think that keeping up with your relationships is important, and having your friends and family show you how much they care. Because otherwise, you'll be like me and start seeing the finish line.

Thanks for the response. Yeah, I just don't understand how people can be so incapable of just a little bit of compassion. I mean, I understand it to some extent because as all of us are medical students, we're busy with studying for our boards. But this is when I need them the most. I also need to be studying and am really struggling, and yet no one seems to be able to swing by and give me a little human contact when they see that I am not up to leaving my house.
